image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a common iguana (Iguana iguana) perched on a blue wooden railing. The iguana is facing slightly to the right, showcasing its head, upper torso, and front limbs. The background is a blurred blue body of water. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the texture of the scales.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is large and triangular with a prominent dewlap (loose skin fold) hanging from the throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is distinctly triangular and robust. A significant fold of skin (dewlap) is clearly visible hanging from the lower jaw/throat area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large with round pupils and golden irises.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible eye is large, the pupil appears round, and the iris has a distinct golden/orange hue consistent with the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: A large circular subtympanic shield (scale) is present below the tympanum.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A very prominent, large, pale circular scale is clearly visible on the side of the head, posterior to the eye and inferior to the ear opening, matching the description of the subtympanic shield.
The visible portion of the torso appears thick and muscular, consistent with a robust build.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coloration is bright green in juveniles, becoming darker green to greyish-green in adults with broad black bands on the body and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The iguana in the image displays orange/yellow coloration on the limbs and grey/brown tones on the body, lacking the 'bright green' or 'greyish-green with black bands' described in the specific checkpoint text. While this coloration exists in real iguanas (morphs), it strictly fails the provided textual checkpoint description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Row of enlarged, spine-like scales running from the nape along the midline of the back to the tail base, forming a serrated crest.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct row of spines (crest) is visible running down the neck and back. The spines are well-defined and structurally sound.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is covered in small, granular scales with larger, plate-like scales on the head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture analysis shows fine, bead-like granular scales on the body and limbs, transitioning to larger, irregular plate-like scales on the face and jaw.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are long and muscular with five clawed digits on each foot.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both front limbs are visible. They are muscular. The digits are clearly separated, and five digits with claws are countable on both the left and right feet.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and longer than body, used for balance and defense.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail extends out of the frame behind the iguana. Its full length and compression cannot be verified from this cropped view.
